[P2] Finish examples-package coverage for llm.ask

The examples fixture covers the four decider methods, but `llm.ask` still lacks examples-package coverage. This handler requires manual deployment, and the live test is skipped in the regular suite. Root AGENTS.md Tests rule 3 and CONTRIBUTING require examples for new public APIs. Return to the testing design and cover `llm.ask` through the examples workflow with result and history assertions. An injected Bedrock client can provide deterministic replies without a deployed model.
